blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Mark Villar has joined the Senate majority bloc, Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri said on Thursday. Zubiri made the confirmation after the 13-member majority bloc elected Villar as chairman of the Senate committee on public works and a member of the Commission on Appointments (CA). READ: Legarda regrets siding with minority group, says Lacson “Yes, we just elected him to the CA and Public Works committee as part of the majority,” Zubiri said in a Viber message when asked if Villar is now part of the majority group. /jpv...
